title: Ow
question: Must Andy go to see the doctor?

meanings.usage: 过去式为fell，表示失去平衡而倒下
表示位置或动作的方向
过去式和过去分词均为hurt，可指身体或感情上的伤害
从坐或躺的状态变为站立
指从躺着或坐着的姿势起来
常用于I'm afraid that...句型，表示遗憾或歉意
用于检查身体内部，如骨折等
常用于What's the matter?询问情况
let me help you表示主动提供帮助
I'm sure that...表示确信某事

phrases.usage: 用于询问他人发生了什么问题或状况

examples.en: What's the matter, Andy?

phrases.usage: 表示滑倒并摔下来的动作

examples.en: I slipped and fell downstairs.
examples.zh: 我从楼梯上滑倒摔下来了。

phrases.usage: 表示伤害到自己，常用于询问是否受伤

examples.en: Have you hurt yourself?
Can you stand up?

phrases.usage: 表示从地上或躺着的位置起来

examples.en: I'm afraid that I can't get up.
I think that the doctor had better see you.
examples.zh: 我认为你最好让医生看看。

examples.en: The doctor says that he will come at once.
I'm sure that you need an X-ray, Andy.
examples.zh: 我确信你需要做X光检查，安迪。

phrases.usage: 表示遗憾地告诉某人某事，或表示担心

examples.en: I'm afraid that I can't get up.
Let me help you.

sentences.zh: 我滑了一下，从楼上摔下来了。

sentences.en: I think that I've hurt my back.
I'm afraid that I can't get up.
I think that the doctor had better see you.
sentences.zh: 我认为你最好去看医生。

sentences.en: The doctor says that he will come at once.
I'm sure that you need an X-ray, Andy.
sentences.zh: 安迪，我肯定你需要拍X光片。

exercises.explain: slip · /slɪp/ · verb · 滑倒；滑落。指意外滑倒，常与and连用

source.en: I'm sure that you need an X-ray, Andy.

exercises.prompt: “that可省略，用于补充说明主句动词的内容” 描述的是哪个语法点？
exercises.hint: 主语 + think/believe/sure + that + 从句
options: 定语从句（Relative Clauses）- 关系代词who/which/that
Can 引导的一般疑问句
Have/Has + 过去分词（现在完成时）
exercises.explain: 宾语从句 (that引导)：主语 + think/believe/sure + that + 从句：that可省略，用于补充说明主句动词的内容

选出下面句子的正确中文意思：
Ow!

grammar.title: 现在完成时 (Present Perfect Tense)
grammar.definition: 由have/has + 过去分词构成，表示过去发生的动作对现在造成的影响，或表示动作持续到现在
grammar.structure: 主语 + have/has + 过去分词 + (时间状语/地点)
grammar.usage: 用于描述过去发生但与现在有关联的事情。在本课中，Have you hurt yourself? 询问的是过去发生的动作对现在的 影响

examples.en: I have slipped and fallen downstairs.
examples.zh: 我从楼梯上滑倒摔下来了。

examples.en: Have you hurt yourself?
Yes, I have. I think that I've hurt my back.
examples.zh: 是的，我伤到了。我想我伤到背了。

grammar.title: had better 的用法
grammar.definition: had better表示建议或劝告，意为"最好"，含有轻微的警告或催促意味
grammar.structure: 主语 + had better + 动词原形
grammar.usage: 用于在特定情况下建议某人采取行动，语气比should稍强，比must弱

examples.en: I think that the doctor had better see you.
examples.zh: 我认为你最好让医生看看。

examples.en: You had better see a doctor.

grammar.title: 宾语从句 (that引导)
grammar.definition: 由that引导的宾语从句，用于表达思想、观点或确信的内容
grammar.structure: 主语 + think/believe/sure + that + 从句
grammar.usage: that可省略，用于补充说明主句动词的内容

examples.en: I think that I've hurt my back.
I'm sure that you need an X-ray.
examples.zh: 我确信你需要做X光检查。

examples.en: What's the matter with you?
What's the matter, Tom?

patterns.pattern: Have you + 过去分词 + (反身代词)?

examples.en: Have you cut yourself?
Have you burned yourself?

original.en: I think that I've hurt my back.

examples.en: I believe that he is sick.
I'm sure that you need rest.

patterns.pattern: Sb. had better + 动词原形

original.en: I think that the doctor had better see you.
original.zh: 我认为你最好让医生看看。

examples.en: You had better go home.
She had better see a doctor.
